tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Page background: the newsprint the puzzle sits on.

tokens.name: cell
tokens.usage: White squares, and any raised surface (clue panels, secondary buttons). Always framed by grid-line or rule, since it sits close to paper.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and pen entries, on paper, cell and word. Also the primary button fill.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Bylines, metadata, solved clues and clue numbers outside the grid; on paper and cell.

tokens.name: rule
tokens.usage: Decorative hairlines between sections and around panels. Never the only thing separating meaning.

tokens.name: grid-line
tokens.usage: Grid hairlines and the grid's outer frame; 3:1 or better against cell and paper in both themes.

tokens.name: block
tokens.usage: Black squares. In Night edition they turn graphite (same as grid-line) so they stay 3:1 against dark cells instead of vanishing.

tokens.name: highlight
tokens.usage: The active cell — the cursor. Always paired with an inset on-highlight ring so it never rests on colour alone.

tokens.name: on-highlight
tokens.usage: Letters, numbers and marks inside the highlighted cell, and its inset cursor ring (9.8:1 or better).

tokens.name: word
tokens.usage: Tint for the rest of the active word and the active clue row. A supporting cue: the active word is always named in the ClueBar too.

tokens.name: check
tokens.usage: Wrong-letter marks: the letter plus a diagonal slash. Text-safe on cell, paper and word in both themes.

tokens.name: reveal
tokens.usage: Revealed letters plus a corner flag; also links and the focus ring. Text-safe on cell, paper and word.

tokens.name: pencil
tokens.usage: Pencil-mode guesses, set lighter weight than pen; on cell and word.

tokens.name: on-ink
tokens.usage: Text on an ink fill (the primary button label).

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Backdrop behind a modal Dialog. Dims the page so the dialog is the only active surface; the dialog itself is framed by an ink border, never a shadow.

tokens.name: link
tokens.usage: Inline links — an alias of reveal.

families.sans: "Libre Franklin", "Franklin Gothic Medium", "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif

groups.name: Editorial
groups.note: Newsreader (Google Fonts): titles and clue text — the voice of the puzzle.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Puzzle titles and the solved screen. One per view.

styles.name: clue
styles.usage: Every clue, in lists and in the ClueBar.

groups.name: Interface
groups.note: Libre Franklin (Google Fonts): the newspaper grotesque for controls, labels and the grid.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Fill every white square so each row and column spells a word.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Uppercase section labels (ACROSS, DOWN), clue chips like 14A, the timer.

groups.name: Grid
groups.note: Set at the 40px cell; scale both with the cell (letter 60%, number 25%).

styles.name: cell-letter
styles.usage: Pen entries in a 40px cell. Pencil entries drop to weight 400.

styles.name: cell-number
styles.usage: Clue numbers, top-left of the cell.

spacing.note: 4px base; the grid itself is measured in cells, not spacing steps.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Number-to-text gap in a clue row.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Inside chips and compact controls.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Between clue rows; ClueBar inner padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Panel padding; button side padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between the grid and the clue lists.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Between page sections.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Page margins at desktop width.

radius.note: Square, like the grid. The only curves are circled squares.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Cells, the grid, panels, the ClueBar.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Buttons and clue chips — just enough to read as pressable.

tokens.name: radius-circle
tokens.usage: Circled squares (theme cells) only.

size.note: Cell sizes. Letters and numbers scale with the cell.

tokens.name: cell-sm
tokens.usage: Phone-width 15×15 grids and thumbnails.

tokens.name: cell-md
tokens.usage: The default cell.

tokens.name: cell-lg
tokens.usage: Minis (5×5) and the cover.

stroke.note: Line weights, all drawn in grid-line or rule.

tokens.name: stroke-hair
tokens.usage: Lines between cells; panel and rule hairlines.

tokens.name: stroke-frame
tokens.usage: The grid's outer frame and the active cell's inset ring.

shadow.note: No elevation shadows: the system is flat ink on paper. The only shadow is the focus ring.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus on buttons, clue rows and the grid: a 2px paper gap, then 2px solid reveal blue (6:1 or better on paper in both themes).
